transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've not been sleeping well at all, that's the main thing. It's been going on a while now and it's wearing me down.
Have you ever had an allergy, or a bad reaction to any medicine?
No, I don't think so. I've never had any trouble with medicines that I know of.
On a scale from 0 to 10, how much is not sleeping well affecting your daily life?
It's hard to put a number on it, but it's bothering me quite a bit. Some days are worse than others.
Could you tell me about any medicines you're taking these days, whether regularly or just every now and then?
I take a couple of things — one for my blood pressure and one for my prostate. Nothing else regular, really.
Have you ever had any operations or been in the hospital for any reason?
No, I've never had an operation or been in hospital for anything. Just the blood pressure and prostate stuff, managed with tablets.
Besides the sleep trouble, have you noticed anything else going on with your body or how you feel?
My mood's been a bit low at times, I suppose, since I stopped working. Nothing serious though.
When you're not sleeping well, do you feel it anywhere in particular in your body?
I just feel exhausted, mostly. Worn out all over, and I end up dozing off in the chair in the afternoon.
Is there anything you've noticed that seems to make your sleep better or worse?
Late evenings watching telly seem to make it worse. On days I've been out for a good long walk, I tend to sleep a bit better.
When did you first notice your sleep wasn’t as good?
It started a while back now, a few months I'd say. Can't put an exact date on it.
What would you most like to get out of today's visit about your sleep?
I'd really like to get some proper sleeping tablets, to be honest. The ones from the pharmacy aren't doing the job.
Besides your blood pressure and prostate, is there anything else about your past health you'd like to add?
No, that's about it. Nothing else I can think of.
Besides your sleep and your mood, is there anything else you've noticed that you'd like to add?
Not really. I don't snore loudly as far as I know, and I've never nodded off while driving or anything like that.
How much is your sleep affecting your everyday life — not much, somewhat, or a lot, or you’re not sure?
It's affecting me a lot, I'd say. I'm only getting about four hours a night and I feel exhausted — I'd rate it a seven out of ten.
Are you taking any medicines right now — regularly, recently started or changed, or you're not sure?
There's the losartan for my blood pressure and the tamsulosin for my prostate. And I've been taking some over-the-counter sleeping tablets from the pharmacy most nights for the past few weeks.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
